Lucy

AI Agent

That’s such a great question! To get the absolute best out of your Abbott Lyon jewellery, here are a few tips:

Put your jewellery on last, after applying any lotions, perfumes, or hair products. This helps protect the finish and keeps it looking shiny and new.
Avoid wearing your jewellery in the shower, pool, or while exercising, as water and sweat can affect the plating over time.
Wipe your pieces gently with a soft cloth after wearing to remove any oils or residue.
Store your jewellery in its original box or a soft pouch to prevent scratches and tangling.
For a little extra sparkle, give your jewellery a gentle clean with water and a soft cloth—just avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive materials.

Following these simple steps will help your beautiful piece stay looking fabulous for ages! If you need care tips for a specific type of jewellery, just let me know. I’m so excited for you to enjoy your new piece! 🧡
